objective: Determine whether an RL-guided joint search over ordinary prime-field isogeny vertices and typed factor-base presentations is specified well enough to justify implementation and a bounded held-out-prime experiment.

candidates.title: RL-guided isogeny and factor-base presentation search
candidates.uncertainty: Whether a leakage-resistant, true-solver-reward MDP can use the existing certified isogeny graph machinery to search richer factor-base presentations at cryptographic-scale graph sizes where exhaustive enumeration is unavailable.
candidates.positive_decision: Admit a frozen hypothesis and bounded implementation/measurement protocol only if the design specifies the MDP, true-cost reward, equal-budget baselines, held-out-prime generalization gate, and end-to-end claim boundary.
candidates.negative_decision: Record the first exact design obstruction, such as a non-Markov state, incommensurate reward, unavoidable train/test leakage, or an action space that reduces to an already measured class-constant presentation family.
candidates.inconclusive_decision: Revise the design without implementation when true-solver reward, generalization, or baseline comparability remains underspecified.
candidates.next_action: Run TASK-20260903-18a803, snapshot its five artifacts, then perform a Coordinator admission decision.

ambiguities.question: Does RL search only curve vertices?
ambiguities.resolution: No. Curve-only F1/F2/F3 families were measured class-constant; the action must jointly change a typed factor-base/decomposition presentation.

ambiguities.question: Can a cheap learned surrogate define success?
ambiguities.resolution: No. It may schedule expensive evaluations, but every promoted candidate must be re-measured by the actual solver under the same normalized system and budget.
ambiguities.basis: controls-before-belief and the user's Groebner/root-computation objective

candidates.dominated_by: Existing certified exhaustive enumeration at toy p for coverage; Pollard rho for end-to-end ECDLP cost until a full attack improvement is independently established.

sota_delta.time: unknown; target is more best-so-far true solver-cost improvement per fixed evaluation budget than random/greedy/bandit baselines
sota_delta.memory: unknown and charged in the reward plus end-to-end accounting
sota_delta.data_or_query: unknown; every true solver evaluation and graph oracle query is charged
sota_delta.note: No realized delta exists at admission.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: A complete, testable MDP and protocol, or one exact obstruction showing the requested RL formulation cannot discriminate its target under fair controls.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: Revise before code if the reward can be gamed, the action space is class-constant, or held-out-prime generalization cannot be measured.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Proxy-only gains, vertex leakage, unmatched factor-base density, uncharged isogeny/preprocessing cost, timeout-as-hardness, or comparison to only a random policy forces REVISE.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: The producer artifacts are snapshot-archived and the Coordinator completes the admission review.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Static mathematical and experimental design plus source and overlap audit.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One Idea Generator producer, one Coordinator snapshot archive, one later admission decision.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after one schema-complete design package or the first exact formulation blocker.

stages.stop_rule: Stop on a failed binding or overlap check.

claims.statement: At most one implementation-ready RL mechanism and protocol boundary may be proposed; no measured gain or cryptanalytic result is claimed.
claims.scope: Zero-run design over ordinary generic-prime-field curves, isogeny moves, and typed point-decomposition presentations.
claims.target_result: Complete design, exact scoped obstruction, or REVISE.
